edges.description: The partially initialized oid buffer (with uninitialized byte at position len) propagates from the asn1_read_value call site to the strcmp sink without any intervening null-termination. Verified: oid_byte_at_len=127 at both events, confirming the non-null-terminated state reaches strcmp.

root_cause_criterion.description: The root cause is the missing explicit null-termination of oid after asn1_read_value. The code reserves space (len = sizeof(oid) - 1) but never writes oid[len] = '\0'. The fix should add explicit null-termination after asn1_read_value returns ASN1_SUCCESS. The provided patch (fix commit) only changes documentation comments and does not fix this vulnerability (patch_resolves: false).
